# convertMarkdownToRichText

<link-summary>Turns a small subset of Markdown into styled text runs.</link-summary>

<web-summary>convertMarkdownToRichText() — Turns a small subset of Markdown into styled text runs. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/slide</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function convertMarkdownToRichText(text: string, theme: Theme = {}): RichTextRun[];
```

Bold, italic, code and links are recognised and become runs carrying the style each one implies, ready to be written into a slide or a cell. A theme can change what those styles are — the font of a code run, say — without touching the text.

## Parameters

| Parameter                   | Type     | Description                           |
| :-------------------------- | :------- | :------------------------------------ |
| `text`                      | `string` | The Markdown to convert.              |
| `theme` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `Theme`  | The styles each kind of run is given. |

## Returns

`RichTextRun[]` — the runs, in order, each with its text and its style.

## Examples

### In use

```javascript
const runs = convertMarkdownToRichText("**bold** and `code`");
```
